## Context and Problem Statement

Cross-team architectural decisions were getting made in ad hoc threads.

## Considered Options

- No standing meeting
- A weekly synchronous design-sync meeting

## Decision Outcome

Hold a weekly design-sync meeting for cross-team architectural decisions.

## Consequences

Retired without a replacement once the team went fully async; see the
deprecation record for rationale.
